# WP1 icons: bounded implementation contract

**Proposal only, 2026-10-23. Implement after feedback/panel acceptance and explicit ownership handoff.** The parent owns canonical specs, PLAN, RECONCILE and root docs. This lane wrote only this new directory; it performed no repository edits, builds, package commands, network, browser, device, media, converter or native execution.

Use [proposed-manifest.json](proposed-manifest.json), its closed [schema](manifest.schema.json), and [decision list](decisions.md). Selection: **36 concepts; 48 Material names; 54 Android artwork variants; 58 contextual Android bindings; 50 distinct SF literals**. Four SF additions are explicit common menu/badge contexts, without preflight availability proof. The original 46 retain only the preflight's local catalog evidence. The [96 accepted inputs](../inputs-bluetooth-replacement/accepted-inputs.json) are an artwork superset; **42 pairs remain unselected**. No decision here changes an accepted input or canonical requirement.

Binding evidence: current [F00 §11](../../spec/00-foundations.md#11-iconography), S10/S20/S30/S40/S50/S60 references embedded in the manifest, [input handoff](../inputs-bluetooth-replacement/handoff.md), [axis/family/license audit](../inputs-bluetooth-replacement/evidence-audit.json), [preflight](../preflight.md), and [accepted token slice](../../wp1-tokens/acceptance.md). Prior preflight conflict and input-gate passages are historical: the parent reconciled them. Bluetooth is the accepted generic `bluetooth` route kind, with meaning supplied by the route label/value.

## Selection and schema

`concepts` follows the 36-row F00 order. Each entry preserves exact source cells and canonical labels, explicit SF literals/system-owned roles, Android state bindings and accessibility guidance. `artwork`, sorted by `(name, fill, autoMirror)`, is the finite set of reusable vectors. Binding count differs from artwork count because e.g. `check` serves both Admit and copied confirmation. Each artwork embeds the **unchanged accepted record**, accepted index pointer and record hash: exact SVG path/bytes/SHA-256, immutable upstream URL/commit/path, axes, metadata eligibility pointers, exact provenance file hash/pointer/record hash, and license path. Nested input paths resolve against the accepted-index directory, not this manifest. No dynamic string aliases or implicit state/fill expansion.

The JSON Schema closes every object, requires all keys and constrains types/enums/constants. [validate-contract.py](validate-contract.py) adds relational checks that JSON Schema cannot express. Numeric FILL is an integer, never boolean/string. A numbered F00 pair is `requirement`; applying the canonical toggle rule is `derived_requirement`; a proposed unspecified fill is `recommendation` with a decision ID. Neither a filled button container nor an Android switch's decorative leading image automatically requires FILL 1. The manifest's labels are documentation for native localization, not strings stored in an `ImageVector`.

All 14 numbered F00 pairs are retained. The other 37 names are inventoried in [decisions.md](decisions.md): use one fill except justified `group`, `present_to_all` and `keep` contexts. Back **and Send** auto-mirror; other artwork explicitly does not. Do not make disabled, pressed, focused, unread, permission, host-lock or busy states into new artwork unless a separate glyph is actually specified. Overlays, spinner and native enabled/selected semantics belong to their control.

Future build-time validation must reject before writing: duplicate JSON keys; unknown fields/schema versions; duplicate or colliding concept/state/native identifiers; missing, unused or mismatched inputs; changed source/provenance/license hashes; wrong family/axes; ineligible metadata rows; undeclared fills; unexplained contextual symbols; invalid labels/roles; unexpected mirroring; unsupported SVG; and output path escapes/symlinks. Resolve paths under an explicit vendored allowlist; no network fallback, placeholder glyph or best-effort output. Metadata rows retain array identity; never collapse by name.

Determinism: UTF-8/LF, fixed ordering, stable numeric formatting and generator/profile version; headers identify manifest and source hashes, never timestamps, absolute machine paths or transient tool versions. Use exact-decimal arithmetic through parsing/translation; serialize reviewed finite Float literals deterministically, normalize negative zero and report Float32 conversion error. Future generation stages all outputs under its owned directory, validates them, then replaces only its enumerated files; never leave partial output on input errors. `--check` is read-only, fails on missing/stale/extra generated outputs and does not rewrite expectations. Errors are nonzero with a stable code, manifest pointer, source asset/path, token/segment offset and reason; no swallowed unsupported command. Suggested codes: `E_SCHEMA`, `E_ID`, `E_INPUT`, `E_HASH`, `E_PROVENANCE`, `E_LICENSE`, `E_SVG_PROFILE`, `E_PATH`, `E_OUTPUT_DRIFT`.

## Strict converter contract

The inspected **96** SVGs all have SVG namespace, `width="24"`, `height="24"`, `viewBox="0 -960 960 960"`, one direct `<path d="…">`, and no other content/attributes. Actual letters: **M m L l H h v Q q T t Z**; 42 files have implicit parameter repetitions. The bounded converter profile supports both cases of **M/L/H/V/Q/T/Z**, including V/z even though absent here. Do not generalize from their absence or silently treat an unsupported command as a line.

1. Parse XML with DTD/entity/network resolution disabled. Reject DTDs, entities, processing instructions, comments/CDATA, additional namespaces/attributes, text, child elements, groups, transforms, CSS, explicit paints, stroke, clipping, gradients, resources and references. For this profile accept only the exact observed dimensions and path structure. A different viewport or SVG feature requires an explicit profile amendment, never automatic repair.
2. Tokenize full path grammar: signed integers/decimals, leading-dot decimals, adjacent signs, allowed whitespace/comma separators, optional finite decimal exponents; reject leftovers, doubled/misplaced commas, NaN/infinity, incomplete groups and arguments after close. Resource bounds are proposed as 128 KiB per SVG, 128 characters per numeric token and 10,000 expanded segments; fail excess rather than truncate. Every path starts with M/m. Command arities are 2,2,1,1,4,2,0 respectively.
3. Interpret in **source coordinates** with current point `(0,0)`, subpath start, previous segment kind and last quadratic control. Expand every implicit repeat. First M/m pair starts a subpath; subsequent pairs are L/l, with each relative pair based on the updated current point. Relative h/v affect only the specified axis; H/V become explicit line endpoints. Preserve zero-length segments and repeated points.
4. Q/q consumes one control and endpoint, both relative to the segment's starting point for q. T/t reflects the immediately preceding Q/q/T/t control around the current point; otherwise its control is the current point. Repeated T groups reflect the control produced by the preceding group. M/L/H/V/Z reset quadratic reflection. Z/z emits close, moves current point to the subpath start, and resets reflection; a subsequent relative m is relative to that restored point. Preserve subpath ordering, directions and closures.
5. **Then** translate every absolute endpoint and quadratic control by **`(0,+960)`** into a 960×960 zero-origin viewport. No Y flip, scale-to-24 coordinate rewrite or delta translation. If an implementation retains relative operations, only absolute positions get the offset; first relative moveto must still start from the correctly translated origin. Prefer normalized absolute M/L/Q/Z operations to make this auditable.
6. Emit native `moveTo`, `lineTo`, `quadTo` and `close` operations, maintaining one compound path with **NonZero** winding. SVG defaults here are black fill/no stroke; output uses a solid neutral fill and caller tint. Preserve holes and self-overlap behavior; do not reverse contours, merge subpaths, simplify curves, deduplicate commands, switch to EvenOdd or independently fill each contour. Default dimensions 24 dp; viewport 960×960. Coordinate normalization is an interpreted operation stream, **not copying `d` into a string or prepending an offset**.

No converter was implemented in this lane. XML/lexical checks in validation establish input structure, not normalization, smooth-reflection correctness, winding or native appearance.

## Native delivery and gallery

Proposed implementation homes remain those in the preflight: build-time manifest/script under `packages/ui-tokens`; `Sources/Conclave/Skip/ui/icons/ConclaveIcons.kt`; a native-only iOS symbols file under `Sources/Conclave/DesignSystem/iOS`; and separate debug gallery files beside existing hosting fixtures. Names and paths are proposals to be reconciled with the accepted feedback/panel tree before editing. Do not assume its final API or modify its active work.

Android: one `internal object ConclaveIcons` namespace in the real module with explicitly named, per-variant `internal val` accessors (manifest `kotlin_property`). Use a thread-safe cached lazy `ImageVector` per property; identity is stable on repeated access and construction runs at most once. No eager map of every vector, startup prewarm, body-time parsing or geometry regeneration. Alias-free contextual bindings reuse the same accessor. `autoMirror` is a vector property; callers must not mirror again. Default 24 dp, rendered 24/20/18 dp by context, not distinct source sizes.

iOS: native-only `#if os(iOS) && !SKIP` immutable `static let String` constants for the selected literal symbols in a namespace with no runtime cases. No shared/transpiled runtime icon enum, symbol-name resolver or automatic `.fill` suffix. The manifest is shared **build-time data**, not an extra UI state owner. Back and AVRoutePickerView remain system-owned. Close retains `xmark` plus the system role route. `.monochrome` is the default; iOS 26 flat rendering and `ButtonRole.close` require native runtime guards with iOS 17 paths. The preflight alone supports existence of its 46 symbols by iOS 17; it does not prove a rendered minimum-OS pass or the four additions. All API guards, iOS 17/current symbol lookup/rendering, and Android minimum-OS runtime checks remain open.

The gallery is inert, lazy, opt-in and debug-only, preserving existing normal/Release entry behavior and original hosting fixture functions. Scrollable rows use stable concept/state keys and instantiate vectors only as requested. Show exact selected variants with human-readable concept/state captions; sample toggles alter only fixture state. No live mic, camera, route selection, sharing, call, feedback/haptic or session side effects. Route/system-owned iOS cases are explanatory placeholders in the inert fixture unless a separately authorized harmless native example is chosen. Avoid an eager `allIcons` vector list. UI controls own one localized label/value/role; images inside them are decorative/null. Status icons merge into adjacent row/tile text, not additional focus targets. A standalone meaningful image requires explicit localized copy. New production consumers, legacy bridge removal, token changes, dependency/R8 changes and bootstrap work are separate adoption gates.

The later adaptive inspector/retained-stage extension consumes the **same accepted coordinator** in a separate slice. This icon work creates no second panel or navigation owner and cannot establish renderer/media retention.

## Future verification gates

Keep these **three independent** layers; none ran here:

- **Parser semantic fixtures, hand-authored expected geometry:** `m10 -950 20 0 0 20z` must yield translated M(10,10), L(30,10), L(30,30), Z; `M10 -950q10 0 10 10t10 10` must yield Q control(20,10)/end(20,20), then reflected control(20,30)/end(30,30). Add repeated absolute/relative Q/T, T after line/move/close (no reflection), H/V, initial relative m, relative m after close, mixed subpaths, signed/decimal/exponent separators, and malformed operand/error fixtures. A compound outer/inner contour with opposite winding must retain its hole; same-winding nested contours remain filled. Test close after curves and zero-length segments. Expected coordinates, bounding boxes and interior/exterior samples must be independently fixed, not generated by the converter under test.
- **Independent geometry and pixels:** compare endpoints/control points, extrema/bounds, signed contour areas or sampled winding coverage against an independently authored interpreter/reference; do not call the same normalizer twice. For all 54 assets, rasterize the **original unmodified SVG bytes with an independent already-available offline SVG renderer**; separately capture/draw the native `ImageVector` at 18/20/24/48 dp and controlled density. Use identical viewport mapping, solid tint, background and color space, crop bounds and no motion. Compare alpha/silhouette, holes, connected components, occupied bounds and image diffs; inspect RTL Back/Send against a separately mirrored reference. Fix thresholds before reviewing candidate results: e.g. no interior/hole mismatch away from a one-pixel antialias edge band, no occupied-bound displacement >1 raster pixel, report MAE and changed-pixel fraction with retained overlay/diff artifacts. Calibrate backend edge tolerance on trusted fixtures, not on generated icon failures. If no independent local renderer exists, leave that gate open; do not fetch a dependency or call output-regeneration agreement a visual test. Run offline/silent after the build/device owner authorizes it; no call/media permission is needed.
- **Regeneration and native integration:** a separate drift check proves manifest/input/profile → exact checked-in outputs, including negative cases and missing/extra files. It does not prove geometry. Compile every constant/vector in the real native module; verify lazy identity/default size/viewport/mirroring, zero unused vector construction before gallery access, symbol lookup on iOS 17/current, themed/RTL/largest-type semantics and normal/Release preview rejection. Parent serializes native quality gates and freezes the candidate for independent review and silent runtime. Spoken accessibility, performance, physical devices and production media acceptance remain distinct.

## License propagation

Carry the **exact unmodified Apache-2.0 LICENSE including appendix**, SHA-256 `58d1e17ffe5109a7ae296caafcadfdbe6a7d176f0bc4ab01e12a689b0499d8bd`, with vendored inputs and recipients of generated source/object distributions. A source SPDX header or link alone is insufficient. Preserve applicable upstream copyright, patent, trademark and attribution notices from the source forms. Every generated/modified vector file prominently states that Conclave converted the Google Material Symbols artwork (SVG parsing/translation to native path operations), with pin, input/manifest hash references and a path to the complete license. Keep original SVGs unchanged.

Retain factual attribution “Material Symbols by Google”; identify it as local attribution, not an invented upstream NOTICE. If an applicable upstream NOTICE accompanies later scoped inputs, propagate its readable relevant notices as Apache §4(d) requires. Current evidence says only that the pinned **root tree and retained files** contain no applicable upstream NOTICE; it is not a recursive repository-wide proof. Do not attribute the updater's copyright year or the license appendix placeholder to artwork, and do not copy the updater/documentation into runtime sources. iOS SF artwork is not vendored or relicensed as Google artwork.

Future packaging must include the full license in distributed Android assets and the iOS module's bundled third-party notices if those distributions include the derived work, and in source distribution. Report the exact packaged paths and inspect archive contents under the later build owner; no packaging proof exists now. No repository root license is replaced.

## Evidence from this lane

Run `python3 -B /tmp/conclave-overhaul/wp1-icons/manifest-contract/validate-contract.py` from any directory. It reads only and prints a report; [validation.json](validation.json) records this pass. Checks cover closed schema, seven spec hashes, five evidence hashes, 96 local SVG hashes/52,263 bytes/87 payload hashes, provenance pointers and hashes, license, preserved per-row family eligibility, exact core-table/label inventory, 54 selected pairs, all numbered fills, 37 ambiguity decisions, identifiers, mirror flags and cited SF literals. SVG checks cover strict structure and lexical/operand groups only. Spec references are bounds-checked; prose interpretation was independently reviewed, not algorithmically proven. [decisions.md](decisions.md) records the review and deliberate feature exclusions.

This is a reviewable contract, **not build, native/runtime, feedback/panel, full WP1 or release acceptance**.
